title: in-app ext.adtype='clickunder' hint, top.location.href redirect script, adomain omitted

source.name: ortbtools Core pop-family ext-hint recognition contract (packages/core/non-iab-formats.js STRING_HINT_KEYS, packages/core/rules/pop-request/index.js, packages/core/rules/pop-response/index.js) layered on IAB OpenRTB 2.x Imp/ext extensibility — the product's own documented, in-repo mechanism for pop/clickunder signalling, not a named vendor's wire format
source.version: repo HEAD at session start, commit a61fc25
source.license: Internal product code (ortbtools); no third-party material copied. MIT for the original fixture values.
source.notes: Same mechanism as the sibling adtype cases, with the 'clickunder' string value, an in-app impression, a top.location redirect script, and no bid.adomain — exercises the adomain-absent branch of the pop-landing crosscheck rule.

modifications: All IDs, domains, prices and timestamps independently authored.
device.ip uses TEST-NET 192.0.2.44; user.id is a clearly synthetic string.
advertiser.example.test / tracking.example.test are reserved .test hosts; test.publisher.example.invalid is a reserved .invalid bundle id; no live host, tracker or subscriber identifier.
provenance.sanitized: No real visitor or subscriber data. IP 192.0.2.44 is TEST-NET-1; every identifier is a synthetic-fixture string; every URL/bundle id uses a reserved .test/.invalid name.

pairApplicability.note: A genuine oRTB auction pair: the response bid references the offered impression, ids match, and the ext hint is a Core-recognized, non-vendor-attributed extension convention, not a proprietary wire wrapper.

device.ua: Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 13) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Mobile Safari/537.36

specNotes: packages/core/non-iab-formats.js STRING_HINT_KEYS recognizes imp.ext.adtype='clickunder' — the third documented value of POP_FORMAT_NAMES alongside 'popunder'/'popup' (non-iab-formats.js:30). The finding is the same imp.non_standard_format INFO used by the other two string-hint cases (rules-request.js:527).

`top.location.href = URL` is the third accepted pop adm shape documented in packages/core/rules/pop-response/index.js's header comment ('location.href = URL' / 'top.location = URL' redirect); admLooksLikePop's (top|parent).location branch must accept it.

bid.adomain is intentionally omitted: oRTB 2.6 §3.2.3 Object:Bid lists adomain as RECOMMENDED, not required — response.bid.adomain_missing (WARNING) is the correct, spec-grounded outcome, not an error. With adomain absent, crosscheck.js's pop-landing rule (gated on 'bid.adomain is a non-empty array') is silently skipped — neither adomain_landing_match nor _mismatch may fire.

context=inapp (app.bundle set, device.devicetype=4/tablet) diversifies the context axis away from the web-only siblings; devicetype 4 does not map to CTV (deviceTypeToContext only maps 3/7), so contexts stay ['inapp'].
Browser preview must not open a real popup or dispatch tracking.
notes: Plain `iab` dialect, deliberately not the `ext-rtb` vendor dialect used by the sibling EXADS/Kadam/PPCmate/Adon3 pop cases.

preview.limitation: pop script has no visual body
